statement: "Multo" (lit. 'Ghost') is a song by Filipino band Cup of Joe.
"Multo" is from Cup of Joe's debut studio album, Silakbo (2025).
The song "Multo" was written by co-lead vocalist Raphaell Ridao and his brother Redentor during the COVID-19 pandemic.
"Multo" is a synth-pop and pop-rock ballad.
"Multo" explores themes of grief, emotional haunting, and self-reflection.
"Multo" was produced by Shadiel Chan.
"Multo" signifies a more introspective turn in the band's musical direction.
"Multo" was released on September 14, 2024.
"Multo" was released under Viva Records.
The song "Multo" received favorable reviews from critics.
Many critics described "Multo" as a significant evolution of Cup of Joe's sound.
"Multo" marked a milestone as the first entry by a Filipino artist on the Billboard Global 200.
"Multo" peaked at number 80 on the Billboard Global 200.
In the Philippines, "Multo" topped three national charts.
The national charts topped by "Multo" included the Billboard Philippines Hot 100.
"Multo" held the number one spot for 27 consecutive weeks on the Billboard Philippines Hot 100.
"Multo" is the longest song topping in the Billboard Philippines Hot 100 chart's history.
The song "Multo" broke into the top 10 in the UAE.
The song "Multo" broke into the top 20 in the Netherlands.
The song "Multo" was nominated for People's Choice Awards — Song.
The song "Multo" won Song of the Year at the Filipino Music Awards 2025.
On February 9 and 10, 2024, Cup of Joe held its first solo concert.
Cup of Joe's first solo concert was titled Cup of Joe: Seatbelts on!.
Cup of Joe's first solo concert was held at the New Frontier Theater in Quezon City.
Cup of Joe released its single "Lahat ng Bukas" (2024) on February 9.
The single "Lahat ng Bukas" featured Keanna Mag.
In August 2024, Cup of Joe released the music video for their single "Misteryoso" (2024).
The music video for "Misteryoso" starred Jhoanna Robles.
The music video for "Misteryoso" was directed by Justin de Dios.
To mark its sixth anniversary, Cup of Joe unveiled Dos: The Sixth Joenniversary Special on September 6.
Dos: The Sixth Joenniversary Special is a four‑part live project.
On September 14, Cup of Joe released "Multo" under Viva Records.
Cup of Joe announced the release of "Multo" just three hours before its release.
In March 2025, the music video for "Multo" was released.
The music video for "Multo" featured actors Miles Ocampo and Elijah Canlas.
"Multo" served as the first single of Cup of Joe's first album, Silakbo.
Silakbo (lit. 'Outburst') was released in January 2025.
"Multo" is three minutes and fifty-seven seconds long.
"Multo" was written by Cup of Joe's co-lead vocalist Raphaell Ridao and his older brother Redentor.
Raphaell Ridao and Redentor wrote "Multo" during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.
According to Ridao, he and Redentor were confined to a room during the COVID-19 pandemic.
According to Ridao, he and Redentor found it difficult to process their emotions after they both experienced losing someone.
According to Ridao, he and Redentor eventually turned to songwriting as a means of coping.
The song "Multo" was produced by Shadiel Chan and Jovel Rivera.
The song "Multo" served as an emotional release for both Raphaell Ridao and Redentor.
"Multo" expresses feelings of longing and sadness that had been difficult for its writers to confront.
Musically, "Multo" is a synth-pop and pop rock ballad.
"Multo" was described as melancholic by Elijah Pareño of Rolling Stone Philippines.
"Multo" addresses themes of moving forward in life while being persistently affected by the memory of a past relationship.
"Multo" highlights the process of accepting grief and confronting emotional pain.

The lyrics "Pasindi na ng ilaw" (lit. 'Turn on the lights') and "Minumulto na 'ko ng damdamin ko" (lit. 'I'm being haunted by my feelings') have been interpreted as a metaphor for the group's artistic evolution.
These lyrics reflect a shift from a more playful image to a more introspective exploration of Cup of Joe's musical identity.
"Multo" received favorable reviews from music critics.
Most music critics regarded "Multo" as an evolution for Cup of Joe's sound.
Billboard Philippines' Gabriel Saulog wrote that the song "hits you straight in the feels".
Gabriel Saulog wrote that "sonically, the track itself is a bit more ambitious and experimental for the band, with a hook that lingers deep upon its first full listen".
The Philippine magazine Metroscene observed that the song "Multo" offered a "more refined" version of Cup of Joe's signature sound.
Metroscene named "Multo" as a standout track on Silakbo.
Metroscene explained that "The maturity of the sound really stands out, and it's almost like the band's growing alongside their music".
Elijah Pareño of Rolling Stone Philippines wrote that "Multo" established Cup of Joe as serious musicians and storytellers.
Nylon Manila's Nica Glorioso called the track "Multo" "a beautiful song that does its job of making people feel what the band intended them to feel".
Nica Glorioso described "Multo" as "stirring", "evocative", and "haunting yet cathartic".
Commercially, "Multo" debuted at number 181 on the Billboard Global 200 chart in April 2025.
"Multo" became the first song by a Filipino act to enter the Billboard Global 200 chart.
"Multo" later reached number 80 on the Billboard Global 200 chart.
The track "Multo" entered at number 74 on the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart.
"Multo" marked the highest debut for a Filipino song on the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart.
"Multo" was the first Filipino song to enter the top 100 of the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart.
"Multo" later peaked at number 33 on the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart.
In the Philippines, "Multo" topped the Philippines Hot 100 chart for 27 consecutive weeks.
"Multo" is the longest number one song in the Philippines Hot 100 chart's history.
"Multo" was overtaken by the song "The Fate of Ophelia" by American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift in the week of October 18, 2025.
During the week of October 18, 2025, "Multo" was relegated to No. 3 on the chart.
"Multo" helped Cup of Joe become the first Filipino artist to reach more than 8.3 million monthly listeners on Spotify.
The song "Multo" had an impact on Filipino pop culture.
Nylon Manila and ABS-CBN News reported that "Multo" had become a nearly inescapable viral trend online.
In December 2025, Spotify Philippines declared "Multo" as the Top Local Song of the year.
"Multo" was also recognized by Apple Music Philippines as its Top OPM Song of 2025.
The Filipino teen romance series Ang Mutya ng Section E (transl. The Jewel of Section E) will feature "Multo" in its second season.
